description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Use when an agent asks how good a wallet is as a trader or what a whale holds now: ranks, PnL per window, open positions, recent win rate. Returns JSON ranks, PnL by window, open positions, and recent win rate for that wallet.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0x85ecf584f25db6f146718b86d493e33c5af72052. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
